palette: primary (brand accent), card/border/muted (neutral surfaces), emerald-500/600 (positive/points forts), secondary/destructive (limites, negatif)
typography: font-extrabold headings (H2 text-3xl border-b), font-bold sub-elements, text-muted-foreground body, uppercase tracking-wider small labels under product titles

structural_patterns.lead: p.lead text-lg text-muted-foreground font-medium at article top
structural_patterns.summary_box: bg-primary/5 border border-primary/10-20 rounded-2xl p-6 verdict/TL;DR box near top
structural_patterns.comparison_table: bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl overflow-hidden with divide-y rows, hover:bg-muted/30
structural_patterns.product_card: bg-card border border-border rounded-3xl p-6-8, grid md:grid-cols-[1fr_2fr], image in aspect-square white bg box, points forts (emerald left border) / limites (secondary left border) two-column grid below, CTA buttons row with product-link + data-merchant-links-container for cataloged products or direct merchant buttons (thomann/amazon/woodbrass) for non-cataloged
structural_patterns.configurator_cta: bg-primary/5 border border-primary/20 rounded-2xl centered box near end linking to /configurateur
structural_patterns.faq: details/summary accordion or plain h3+p blocks under h2 FAQ heading
